# Written by `msbctl host kandev install`. The TLS proxy for Kandev's
# sandboxes ([kandev] serve = "proxy"): one listener per published port on
# proxy_listen, each connection checked for a lease token. It reads the kandev
# entries and the certificate itself, so it never needs a restart for them.
[Unit]
Description=msb-manager: TLS proxy for Kandev's sandboxes

[Service]
Type=simple
Environment=PATH=<TMP>/home/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
ExecStart=/opt/msb/bin/msbctl host kandev proxy
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
